root_idea.summary: The root centers on distance and separation.
root_idea.development: This notion develops into removing or driving something away, putting it at a distance, being moved aside, or withdrawing to a remote place.

qac_form_accounting.reason: A Quran-attested verb group, presented under the normalized Classical Arabic perfect citation form.
A Quran-attested active participle with an independently useful nominal headword.

senses.definition: To be removed or driven away from something, especially to a distance.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic occurrence is the passive perfect زُحْزِحَ, with عَنْ marking what a person is removed from; it describes being removed far from Hellfire.

senses.definition: One who or something that removes a person or thing from something else or puts it at a distance.
senses.usage_conditions: The active participle occurs in a بِـ construction with مِنْ, expressing inability to remove someone from punishment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To draw, drag, or pull someone or something away in haste.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a transitive use associated with the contracted form زَحَّهُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To move away, become removed, or move aside; transitively, to remove something or someone away.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The form may be used transitively or intransitively; moving aside to make room is an attested construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Distance; a position at a remove from someone or something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression بِزَحْزَحٍ مِنْهُ, meaning to be at a distance from him or it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place to which one withdraws or moves away; a remote place.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used for a place of retreat or removal, including one far away.

lane_unit_coverage.note: The removal-and-distance branch supports both Quranic forms; the pulling-away-in-haste specialization is separately represented.
